section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a study conducted in Iran to examine the factor structure and psychometric properties of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in a Persian context. The study involved 1093 participants (568 men, 525 women) from seven universities in Tehran. Findings indicated a one-factor solution for the Persian BAS-2, similar to the original English version, with satisfactory convergent validity and internal consistency.
